mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tournament_registrations (tournament_id, user_id, seed, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tournamentId}, #{userId}, #{seed}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.tournament_id, r.user_id, r.seed, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.nickname, u.username, u.avatar_url FROM tournament_registrations r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.tournament_id, r.user_id, r.seed, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.nickname, u.username, u.avatar_url FROM tournament_registrations r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND r.status = 'registered' ORDER BY COALESCE(r.seed, 9999) ASC, r.created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tournament_registrations WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND status = 'registered'
mapper.update: UPDATE tournament_registrations SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tournament_registrations SET seed = #{seed}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tournament_registrations SET status = 'withdrawn', updated_at = NOW() WHERE tournament_id = #{tournamentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'registered'
